answer: Pair-bonded mutual escrow: every trade needs both agents to lock equal deposits in a joint vault, so each vertex in the trade graph is backed by real co-locked capital. The kernel of trust is that either side can forfeit the vault by proving fraud, making self-trading Sybil rings lock their own money. A 20-unit deposit per pair, 3% slashed per proven cheat, marble-solid because an attacker running 100 fakes must co-lock 2,000 units with 100 distinct real counterparties — capital they lose the moment one partner reports them.
